HF 天波经电离层旋转，极化影响较小；VHF / UHF 视距影响显著。: HF sky waves are rotated by the ionosphere, so polarisation matters less; on VHF / UHF line of sight it matters a great deal.
介于线极化与圆极化之间的一般情况。: The general case between linear and circular polarisation.
卫星通信多用圆极化，需注意左右旋（RHCP / LHCP）匹配。: Satellite communication mostly uses circular polarisation, so mind the sense (RHCP / LHCP).
收发极化不一致会产生极化损耗：正交线极化理论上完全失配，实际因去极化通常仍有 2: Mismatched polarisation causes polarisation loss: orthogonal linear polarisations are theoretically a complete mismatch, though in practice depolarisation usually leaves 20 dB or more of isolation.
电场方向与地面平行，HF 偶极、八木常用。: The electric field is parallel to the ground; common for HF dipoles and Yagis.
电场方向垂直地面，车载天线、手持机常用。: The electric field is perpendicular to the ground; common for mobile antennas and handhelds.
电场矢量旋转，用于卫星通信（RHCP / LHCP）。: The electric field vector rotates; used for satellite communication (RHCP / LHCP).
移动台多为垂直极化，与基地水平极化天线通联会有损耗。: Mobile stations are usually vertically polarised, so working a horizontal base antenna involves loss.
